column2: Early golden morning. The front doorstep of a small cosy Vietnamese clay house: sage-green double doors wide open, terracotta tiled step, potted clay plants and flowers either side, pastel shophouses and a parked clay scooter softly blurred in the street behind. A small neat pile of clay leaves on the step.

Dawn. Inside by a wide open window with sage-green clay shutters; a deep clay window sill in the foreground running across the frame, a small clay teapot at the far right of the sill; soft pink-blue sunrise over clay rooftops outside.

Bright noon. A clay kitchen counter running across the frame, striped shadows from sage shutters falling on it; at the right a clay blood pressure monitor and a small glass of water; clay pots and hanging pans on the wall behind.

Sunset. A small round clay kitchen table in the foreground; on its right half a round terracotta clay coin jar with a lotus relief and a slot on top, a clay glass of cà phê sữa đá and a small clay notebook; warm hanging lamp, window with sage shutters and a sunset street behind.

Sunday afternoon. A low round clay family table across the foreground with four different clay tea cups, a clay teapot and a plate of clay fruit on the right; wall behind with a clay lunar tear-off calendar and a small altar shelf with flowers; warm honey light.
Night. A cosy clay bedroom: a bed with a patchwork clay quilt across the foreground, a clay bedside lamp glowing warm at the right, window with blue moonlight, clay moon and stars outside.

Warm evening street corner. A tiny clay cinema ticket booth with a sage-green awning and a row of glowing warm bulbs; the booth counter across the lower middle of the frame; terracotta flower pots either side. No text anywhere.

Blue dusk. The front step of the clay house with a sage-green clay mailbox on the left, a string of warm fairy lights along the doorway, potted plants, a small pile of clay letters on the step. No text anywhere.

A small clay theatre stage with heavy sage-green clay velvet curtains open at both sides, a warm spotlight circle on the stage floor at the centre, a few pink clay rose petals, dark soft background. No text.
